none: PAS CAM-7D9B14: Copper-alloy Radiate Roman Coin of Postumus
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG ; R/ COS IIII

Copper alloy Radiate of Postumus. Principal mint. AD260-269. Reece period 13. Obverse legend reads IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG. Obverse shows Radiate, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse legend reads COS IIII. Reverse shows Nemisis standing facing, head right, holding long vertical palm . //. Die axis 6 o'clock. Weight 2.93g, diameter 20.29mm. Cunetio p.145, no.2455
